name: Skeleton Finger
summary: In Duskwood, Skeleton Finger is gathered from the restless dead. Madame Eva of Darkshire collects these remains with ghoul fangs and spider venom to make protective talismans.

sections.title: Bones of the Restless
sections.body: The dead rise throughout Duskwood, from skeletal raiders and warriors to necrotic mages and fiends. Most travelers leave their foul remains untouched, but fortune tellers and mystics prize their cold essence. Madame Eva, the seer of Darkshire, gathers the bony fingers to bind their lingering necrotic energies into the Totem of Infliction, a ward that strikes back at attackers.

faq.q: What creatures drop a Skeleton Finger?
faq.answer: Skeletal Raiders, Healers, Warders, Warriors, Horrors, Fiends, and Skeletal Mages across Duskwood yield Skeleton Fingers.

faq.q: Who wants Skeleton Fingers in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Madame Eva, the seer of Darkshire, needs Skeleton Fingers for a protective ward.

faq.q: What is the Totem of Infliction?
faq.answer: The Totem of Infliction is a ward Madame Eva makes from skeleton fingers, ghoul fangs, and spider venom. She binds their dark energies into an aura that harms anyone who attacks its bearer.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva need undead remains for a protective charm?
faq.answer: Madame Eva uses the lingering taint and aggression of local creatures in her rituals. She binds the violent essences of Duskwood's skeletons, ghouls, and venomous beasts into a ward that punishes attackers.

angles.text: As a mage studying folk divination, you may find Madame Eva's use of skeletal digits and natural venoms for a retaliatory enchantment an unusual blend of hedge witchcraft and sympathetic magic.
As a paladin, you may shudder at desecrating skeletal remains and carrying their severed parts. In Duskwood's dire gloom, using the bones of the unholy to shield the living is a grim necessity.
